entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Herbert Gollnow was a German resistance fighter, consulate secretary and later second lieutenant in the Luftwaffe. Gollnow career was influenced by Harro Schulze-Boysen while Gollnow studied at the Faculty for Foreign Studies of the Friedrich Wilhelm University in Berlin, and as he rose through the ranks of the Luftwaffe, he became a counter-intelligence officer in the Luftwaffe and an informer to Schulze-Boyen.

Gollnow became a member of a Berlin anti-fascist resistance group that was associated with Schulze-Boysen, that was later called the Red Orchestra. Herbert Gollnow was a military leaders & commanders from Berlin (1911-07-13, Berlin–1943-02-12). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to geopolitics.
